query:
query ($id: ID!, $primaryModel: DataWorksheetTableEnum!, $page: Int, $perPage: Int, $stockIds: [ID!], $searchText: String, $startDate: Time, $endDate: Time, $timeFilterModel: String, $timeFilterField: String, $activeFilterGroupIds: [ID!], $sortColumn: ID, $sortDirection: SortDirectionEnum) {
  dataWorksheetSearch(ids: [$id], primaryModel: $primaryModel) {
    nodes {
      id
      toResult(
        page: $page
        perPage: $perPage
        stockIds: $stockIds
        startDate: $startDate
        endDate: $endDate
        search: $searchText
        timeFilterModel: $timeFilterModel
        timeFilterField: $timeFilterField
        activeFilterGroupIds: $activeFilterGroupIds
        sortColumn: $sortColumn
        sortDirection: $sortDirection
      ) {
        nodes {
          ... on Purchase {
            product {
              code
              __typename
            }
            name
            quantity
            price
            totalValue
            updatedAt
            order {
              shippingFee
              shopReportPrice
              invoiceNumber
              totalDiscount
              shippingType
              name
              contactMethod
              annotation
              createdBy
              transferredAt
              printedAt
              printedBy
              orderBank
              cancelled
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        nodesCount
        pagesCount
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
